new_results: Exact straight-line reduction from exact raw WPRF-value recovery probability epsilon to WPRF distinguishing advantage |epsilon-1/|Y||; the reduction remains QPT when the recovery adversary is QPT with classical output.

Prior-art correction: the desired same-value witness-release functionality is the WPRF / reusable witness-KEM interface; Zhandry already defined process-style extractable WPRF security, but only against PPT adversaries and with sampler/auxiliary-input caveats.

Unconditional public-opening source-extraction barrier: if an auxiliary opening is publicly samplable without a source witness and every accepted opening source-extracts, sampler plus extractor solves source witness search.

Transcript-simulation corollary: an extractor that sees only a transcript perfectly simulatable by the public sampler cannot certify adversary-specific source knowledge without also enabling public source search.
